text:
ida: dropping a tiny prototype: compact threshold chips in the Alerting SLO list + channel mapping preview. main concerns: chip truncation, SR announce semantics when thresholds change, and how channel preview rows should behave when multiple channels map to the same SLO. link: https://redwood-internal.design/alerts/chips-compact-v1.gif sam: Nice! first glance: the chips read dense. question: when a threshold value updates (auto-scaling or API change), should we announce the new value to SR immediately? that could be noisy during bulk updates. leah: I’d avoid immediate live announcements for bulk edits. Plan: batch-change announcements with aria-live="polite" summary like "3 thresholds updated" and allow an opt-in detailed announcement per SLO on expand. mike: Visual suggestion: add an inline icon to chips that indicates mapped channels count (e.g., a tiny link icon + number). when space is tight we could hide the SLO description and expose it in hover/focus only. preeti: Copy nit: for the channel-count affordance say "Mapped to 3 channels" in the tooltip and SR aria-text. avoid ambiguous words like "used by". ida: how should SRs hear per-SLO changes? idea: keep the row aria-label as "{SLO name}, {threshold percent} threshold, mapped to {n} channels" and when someone expands the channel preview we write channel names into an aria-live region. that avoids spamming during background updates. ux-bot: Accessibility suggested pattern: ```html
Errors SLO 95%
``` ux-bot: Notes: batch update summaries should be announced at top-level only and detailed names only on explicit expand. aria-hidden on duplicated visual text to prevent double speech. leah: Agree with the pattern. Also add a small delay (200ms) debounce before writing to aria-live when toggling rapidly via keyboard to avoid repeated reads. test with VoiceOver + NVDA. mike: For truncation: when chip overflows, surface a small ellipsized preview and a focused tooltip that contains full threshold rule and the exact numeric expression (e.g., "p95 > 200ms for 5m"). that tooltip should have role="tooltip" and be reachable via keyboard. preeti: wording for bulk summary: "3 SLOs updated" -> allow expansion: "View changes" which opens a modal with explicit before/after values. keep menu item label as "View changes" not just "Details". ida: good. UX decision: default to hiding channel preview in compact list; expose via toggle. also add a per-user preference: "Always show mapped channels" for power users. sam: small accessibility copy: prefer "notifications suppressed" vs "suppressed" when talking about channel state in the channel preview. keep verbs. ux-bot: Implementation checklist suggestion to add to INF-2550: - row aria-label: "{SLO name}, {threshold label}, mapped to {n} channels" - batch updates announced as "{k} SLOs updated" via single aria-live region - detailed channel names written only to aria-live on explicit expand - debounce live writes on rapid toggle (200ms) - truncation tooltip contains full rule expression; role="tooltip" and keyboard accessible - copy: "Mapped to {n} channels", "View changes", "Snooze notifications" in channel menu - user pref: "Always show mapped channels" leah: I'll add SR test cases: bulk update noise, expand toggle read order, tooltip keyboard access, and prefers-reduced-motion for any chip animations. ida: thanks! i'll update the Figma and attach a prototype. tagging @preeti for copy review. will add acceptance criteria to INF-2550 and schedule a short SR test next week. preeti: I'll review copy after prototype link is up. small ask: include localization notes for the batch summary string. ida: prototype pushed: https://redwood-internal.design/INF-2550/chips-compact-proto (build 2026-03-23-a).
